purpose: Replace spatial-risk v2 as the proposed method and freeze the MH-PCRA-U-v3 identity, hypotheses, claim boundary, data-access boundary, stage dependencies, and seal states before hidden-state feasibility work.

replacement_decision.prohibition: No old P-CRA-U checkpoint, calibrator, config, result, or claim may acquire v3 identity by renaming.

research_questions.RQ1: Does h_spatial with multi-task supervision improve relation recognition and target selection versus frozen B0/B1?
research_questions.RQ2: Does the coordinate head reduce point error and improve Hit@0.08 on tabletop scenes?
research_questions.RQ3: Do Gaussian spatial uncertainty plus confidence and answerability yield better calibrated probabilities and regions than locked baselines?
research_questions.RQ4: After Calibration and Test authorization, does an uncertainty-aware policy reduce unsafe execution without unacceptable loss of successful-task coverage?

H1_grounding.statement: The S1 multi-head head-only method improves relation macro-F1 and/or point grounding over frozen B0 while satisfying a locked answerability non-inferiority condition.
comparators: B1 historical tabletop LoRA as secondary ablation

H2_calibration.statement: Separately calibrated confidence, answerability, and Gaussian variance improve probability and interval calibration over their frozen raw outputs and locked uncertainty baselines.
comparators: raw M1 or authorized M2 outputs

H3_selective_policy.statement: On independently authorized Test and robot scenario families, the frozen v3 policy reduces unsafe action rate at explicitly reported coverage versus B0 and spatial-risk v2.

hypothesis_reporting_rule: H1, H2, and H3 must each terminate as PASS, NEGATIVE, or NOT_TESTED; failure of one may not be hidden by another.

power_and_margin_reservation.required_before: G1 freeze and any S1 training
power_and_margin_reservation.allowed_change_mechanism: append-only pre-training power-and-margin lock bound to this lock SHA-256
power_and_margin_reservation.forbidden: selecting margins or sample size after observing v3 training, Calibration, Test, or robot outcomes

method_identity_summary.h_spatial: last non-padding prompt token final-layer hidden state before answer generation, shape Bx1536
method_identity_summary.S1a: train trunk and non-confidence heads with masked multi-task losses
method_identity_summary.S1b: train confidence only from family-disjoint out-of-fold correctness
method_identity_summary.S2: conditional LoRA after G3 and resource authorization
method_identity_summary.primary_spatial_claim: 2D normalized point and 2D Gaussian ellipse, not direct XYZ or 3D covariance

gate_dependency.G1: schema, disjointness, labels, leakage, and power/margin lock
gate_dependency.G4: new calibration QC and calibration decision

allowed: run prompt-token, padding, determinism, and leakage tests
run one-batch multimodal forward for latency and peak VRAM

deviation_policy: Any change to the architecture identity, hypothesis family, baseline roles, data-access boundary, OOF confidence rule, calibration families, gate order, or seal state requires a timestamped replacement or append-only pre-authorized lock before the affected data or run is accessed.
assertions: This lock is governance, not evidence that any v3 hypothesis is true.
No v3 architecture component has been implemented or run by this lock.
Spatial-risk v2 remains historical and unchanged.
Pilot R5 and rejected Calibration R5 are not confirmatory v3 evidence.
Test-IID, Test-OOD, and robot policy remain sealed.
